text:
Based on the provided abstract, the study is a comprehensive review article that evaluates the strengths and limitations of conventional and novel (microfluidic) isolation methods, summarizes commercially available kits, and assesses global market demand for exosome assays. 

The candidate hypothesis proposes a highly specific experimental platform featuring acoustic microfluidics (1–5 MHz) coupled with electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (1 Hz to 1 MHz), flow rates, specific purity/yield targets (98.5% and >97%), and surface marker targeting. This specific device and set of experimental claims are neither proposed nor supported by the evidence in this review.

VERDICT: REJECT
